description.value:
Duration constant

You may mark a new target as a free action once per round, rather than at the usual cost, but you may never have more than one mark at a time and a mark you abandon cannot be re-established this encounter. Against your mark, your melee Strikes with a one-handed weapon ignore the first 2 points of any resistance.

cinderfall.incomplete: Marking becomes a free action usable once/round, exclusive to one mark at a time; melee Strikes with a one-handed weapon against the mark ignore the first 2 points of its resistance. This class's own target:mark:<slug> predicate idiom is confirmed unfireable (no card anywhere in this corpus ever applies a mark:<slug> option to a target), and separately no rule-element key lets a Strike ignore a target's own resistance value (only Resistance/Weakness grants exist, nothing subtracts or bypasses a target's own value).
